    Avogadro Wiki

    Add molecule models to Minecraft tooltips, build custom viewers, and export images and animations. For Minecraft 1.12.2 on Cleanroom.

    Start here: your first molecule → · Browse all examples

    Build and editPlace atoms, connect reusable pieces, and edit a copy. Match items and fluidsChoose which model appears for an item, fluid, or filled container. Add atom detailsChoose an isotope or charge and inspect an atom’s nucleus and electrons. Chains, networks, and crystalsPEG chains, sulfur crosslinks, adjustable counts, and seeds. Make a viewerDraw a molecule in your screen with its own camera and colors. Export mediaGIF and MP4 output, galleries, and item cards. Commands and importsReload packs, inspect settings, export media, and import CAS substances. Change menu colors with themesBundled palettes, text and icon colors, previews, and your own theme names. Update molecules, read their data, and prepare previewsApply updates together, read loaded data, and discard old background results. TroubleshootingFind the cause of a problem and the next step to try. LanguagesRegister and use the same molecules in your preferred language.
